topics.name: Namespace Migration and Alias
topics.purpose: Define explicit migration/compatibility aliases for legacy namespace names or addresses without allowing aliases to become competing canonical identities.

semantics.alias_rule: Legacy alias maps explicitly to one current canonical namespace identity.
semantics.canonical_rule: Alias never becomes a second authoritative namespace identity.
semantics.direction_rule: Alias mapping direction and supported compatibility period are explicit.
semantics.collision_rule: Alias cannot shadow another active canonical root.
semantics.deprecation_rule: Deprecated aliases retain migration provenance and may be removed only through explicit supersession/retirement policy.
semantics.help_rule: Introspection may display aliases as compatibility metadata while returning the canonical root identity.
semantics.write_rule: Writes/invocations through supported aliases resolve to the same canonical owner/policy as the canonical address.

invariants.rule: Every active reserved runtime root has exactly one explicit owner contract and remains distinguishable from runtime availability, Topic grouping and physical implementation location.

hard_gates.condition: legacy alias becomes competing semantic owner
deprecated alias removed without migration/supersession trace
